body: Build a travel infographic for {{country}} using the supplied verified map. Destinations: {{destinations}}. Route notes: {{routeNotes}}. Render the map as a raised miniature terrain model with a few recognizable landmark miniatures. Add clear city labels, route lines and concise checklists in the margins. Place a small suitcase and compass beside the map. Use a light studio background and readable typography.

en.title: Miniature terrain travel guide
en.description: A verified outline anchors a miniature destination map and labeled route.
en.body:
## How to use

Upload a verified map and supply checked destinations and route notes.

This is an illustrative route diagram; compare label positions with the reference map.

## Recorded result

The example was generated with the built-in image tool. Its exact model ID was not returned. The recorded run contains the submitted prompt and ordered inputs.
## Reference map

The supplied guide uses the main-island outline and city points from [Natural Earth](https://www.naturalearthdata.com/), a public-domain dataset. It is a generalized illustration, with smaller outlying islands omitted.

## Map scope

A schematic illustration of the main islands, with decorative relief and landmarks. The rendered map is not a navigation map; inspect label placement against the supplied reference before publication.

## Checked destination names

City attractions were cross-checked against [GO TOKYO](https://www.gotokyo.org/en/see-and-do/attractions/) and [Kyoto Travel](https://kyoto.travel/en/getting-around/). Decorative landmark miniatures are not map coordinates.

zh-Hans.title: 国家立体地形旅行指南
zh-Hans.description: 以核对后的轮廓为依据，制作带目的地和路线的微缩旅行地图。
zh-Hans.body:
## 使用方法

准备：已核对的地图、目的地清单、路线。以核对后的轮廓为依据，制作带目的地和路线的微缩旅行地图。

## 实测结果

样例由内置图像工具生成，工具未返回精确模型 ID。运行记录保存实际提交的提示词与有序参考图。本站人物、房间、宠物和服饰参考均为原创合成素材。
## 使用边界

地图用于视觉演示，路线与标签需对照参考核查，不提供实时交通信息。

## 参考地图

参考图采用 [Natural Earth](https://www.naturalearthdata.com/) 公共领域地图的主要岛屿轮廓与城市坐标，是省略外围小岛的概括示意图。

## 地图范围

这是日本主要岛屿的示意插画，地形与地标经过艺术化处理，不用于导航。对外使用前应对照参考地图复核文字位置。

## 目的地核对

景点名称对照 [东京官方旅游指南](https://www.gotokyo.org/en/see-and-do/attractions/)与[京都官方旅游指南](https://kyoto.travel/en/getting-around/)核对。装饰性地标模型不代表精确坐标。
